listing.name: SSX 3 (Xbox, PAL) (SSX3-recomp (koenhendriks))
listing.summary: A separate koenhendriks SSX 3 implementation with a Windows x86-64 release and Linux x86-64 source-build racing reported by the project. Asahi Linux ARM64 reaches menus only; native macOS is unsupported. Use your own PAL original-Xbox dump with default.xbe and the complete data/ directory, and point the launcher at that extracted root for its PAL check. The bertibertig and PS2 versions have different inputs and players. Exact accepted XBE revision/hash is unspecified. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
